subject: paper:coghill-sonuga-barke-2012
quote: Taken together, these analyses suggested that ADHD is best modelled as a continuum in both children and adolescents, thus supporting the genetic and other evidence that suggests a dimensional structure and multifactorial aetiology.
rationale: Verbatim from the fetched open-access full text; the canonical review's summary conclusion across three ADHD taxometric studies (Haslam 2006; Marcus & Barry 2011).

subject: paper:mclennan-2016
quote: Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder does not appear to have a taxon.
pageApprox: 'Lack of evidence for a discrete category', para 1
rationale: Verbatim from the cfp.ca full text; a taxon is the formal signature of a real category boundary, and ADHD lacks one.

subject: paper:fassbender-2018
quote: Taxometric analysis outcomes were more consistent with a categorical structure to the data in the group with ADHD and a dimensional structure in the typically developing group.
rationale: Verbatim from the PMC full text; the mandatory rival — a taxometric result recovering categorical (not dimensional) structure within the ADHD group.

subject: paper:faraone-larsson-2019
quote: Both studies suggest that the diagnosis of ADHD is the extreme of a continuous distribution of ADHD symptoms in the population and that the etiologic factors involved in the disorder also account for the full range of symptoms.
pageApprox: 'Evidence for heritability from family, adoption, and twin studies'
rationale: Verbatim from the Nature full text; twin evidence that the same aetiology operates across the whole symptom range, not just at the tail.

subject: paper:demontis-2019
quote: Strong concordance with GWAS of quantitative population measures of ADHD symptoms supports that clinical diagnosis of ADHD is an extreme expression of continuous heritable traits.
rationale: Verbatim from the fetched abstract; molecular (common-variant) evidence for the same conclusion as the twin work.

subject: paper:arildskov-2024
quote: Psychosocial QoL gradually declines in a linear manner as ADHD trait levels increase providing further support for a dimensional model.
rationale: Verbatim from the abstract; impairment rises linearly with trait level with no non-linear breakpoint, so any cutoff is a convention rather than a natural join.

subject: paper:mclennan-2016
quote: the lack of discontinuity in the distribution of such traits in the population creates great uncertainty as to what thresholds should prompt explicit intervention.
rationale: Verbatim from the cfp.ca full text; the practical consequence of continuity for where an intervention threshold should sit.

subject: paper:morton-2025
quote: A review and meta-analysis showed high risks for negative outcomes in a wide range of non-overlapping functional domains in CYP with subthreshold ADHD, compared to children with no ADHD symptoms, including significantly higher rates of family dysfunction, cognitive impairment, executive dysfunction, interpersonal and school deficits, temperament problems, psychiatric comorbidity, and juvenile delinquency.
rationale: Verbatim from the MDPI full text; sub-threshold cases carry real impairment, undercutting the idea that the threshold separates impaired from unimpaired. Medium because it is a narrative review reporting a secondary meta-analysis.

subject: paper:kazda-2021
quote: In this systematic scoping review of 334 published studies in children and adolescents, convincing evidence was found that ADHD is overdiagnosed in children and adolescents. For individuals with milder symptoms in particular, the harms associated with an ADHD diagnosis may often outweigh the benefits.
rationale: Verbatim from the PMC full text; the counter-argument that a continuum does not license unbounded threshold-lowering — a clinically justified action threshold is still required.

subject: paper:burton-2019-swan
quote: ADHD is now widely considered to be the extreme end of widely distributed, quantitative traits (Larsson, Anckarsater, Rastam, Chang, & Lichtenstein, 2012; Levy, Hay, McStephen, Wood, & Waldman, 1997). Although diagnostic categories are useful in clinical practice, dichotomizing continuously distributed traits into case/control reduces statistical power in research.
rationale: Verbatim from the open-access SickKids manuscript; states the continuum framing and the measurement rationale behind dimensional instruments like the SWAN.

subject: paper:kessler-2005
quote: Optimal scoring to predict clinical syndrome classifications was to sum unweighted dichotomous responses across all 18 ASRS questions.
rationale: Verbatim from the Harvard HCP copy; the ASRS — the instrument the personal record uses — is optimally read as a summed dimensional score, not a category. Medium because the quote concerns scoring rather than the trait's population structure directly.

subject: paper:kotov-2017
quote: The traditional externalizing dimension captures comorbidity among substance use disorders, oppositional defiant disorder (ODD), conduct disorder, adult antisocial behavior, intermittent explosive disorder (IED), and attention-deficit-hyperactivity disorder (ADHD).
rationale: Verbatim from the UNT-hosted copy of the published paper; HiTOP places ADHD within a continuous externalizing spectrum.

subject: paper:insel-2010
quote: While maintaining a clear focus on overt psychopathology, investigators will be encouraged to explicate the full range of a given dimension to develop thresholds for different types of interventions and identify early opportunities for preventive interventions.
rationale: Verbatim from the publisher full text; RDoC's core dimensional logic, applied to the executive- and impulse-control constructs central to ADHD.

subject: paper:caspi-2014
quote: Psychiatric disorders were initially explained by three higher-order factors (Internalizing, Externalizing, and Thought Disorder) but explained even better with one General Psychopathology dimension.
rationale: Verbatim from the publisher abstract; the p-factor model on which ADHD loads via the externalizing pole. Medium because the ADHD-specific loading was not confirmable verbatim from primary text.
